originalSteps.name: Upgrade npm to bulk advisory endpoint
Generate current schema contract on PostgreSQL 18
originalSteps.run:
git show HEAD:schema/current-schema-contract.pg18.json > /tmp/committed-schema-contract.pg18.json
npm run schema:contract
cp schema/current-schema-contract.pg18.json /tmp/current-schema-contract.pg18.json
npm run schema:contract:verify -- --fresh /tmp/current-schema-contract.pg18.json --committed /tmp/committed-schema-contract.pg18.json
git checkout -- schema/current-schema-contract.pg18.json
